scoring_justification: Interatomic distances and layer contractions are recomputed from the relaxed XYZ geometries; adhesion energy is recomputed from the total energies and area in the JSON. All quantities are derived from raw artifacts, not trusted from self‑reported values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for interatomic distances, contractions, and adhesion threshold, plus the bulk interlayer reference spacing.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper‑reported values: Al–O and O–C distances ~1.76 Å (Fig.1,2), first‑layer contractions –79.4% (bare) and –(35.3±8.2)% (interface) (Fig.4, text), adhesion energy 1.40 J/m² (DFT calculation text). Bulk interlayer spacing 0.84 Å derived from the DFT‑computed contraction of the reference model.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values taken verbatim from the paper; bulk spacing inferred from the solve.sh coordinates which realize exactly the reported contractions.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All gold numbers are the paper's own published figures, traceable to the article text and figures.

schema.description: Standard XYZ file: first line number of atoms, second line comment, then element x y z per line (Angstrom).

outputs.description: Relaxed coordinates of the bare α-Al₂O₃(0001) slab; the checker recomputes interlayer distances and first-layer contraction.

schema.description: Standard XYZ file: first line number of atoms, second line comment, then element x y z per line (Angstrom).

outputs.description: Relaxed coordinates of the Gr/α-Al₂O₃ interface with bridging O; the checker recomputes Al–O distance, average O–C distance, and layer contractions.

Computed geometric distances, total energies, adhesion energy, and layer contractions. The checker will recompute adhesion energy from the reported total energies and area, and compare distances and contractions to hidden references.

output_contract.notes: All geometric coordinates must be in Angstrom. The adhesion energy must be computed from the three total energies and supercell area, as defined in the workflow.
